notes:
Original locator p.4 is imprecise: overall accuracy correlation is on printed p.276 (PDF p.3). Selected overall deception detection accuracy per neutral description, rather than truth-only or lie-only accuracy. Original participant N=29 is supported by the participant section and r(29) notation; no exclusions reported. Replication title verified against publisher and OpenAlex metadata, but full text unavailable: publisher DOI/full text inaccessible, PDF returned HTTP 403 (not retried); Unpaywall has no OA location; OpenAlex best_oa_location is null and only publisher location; targeted OSF/preprint and author-route searches found no full manuscript. Publisher abstract and preregistration were not treated as full results sources.
Source follow-up: Unassigned side not examined. Online-first proof pagination retained. Rendered PDF4 confirms correlation. Exact p for overall accuracy is not printed. The grouped all ps > .571 sentence explicitly names truth bias, lie accuracy and truth accuracy, so this bound was not assigned to overall detection accuracy.
